 Job Description
 Client is seeking a senior level JAVA/J2EE developer to fill a key role and provide the following services: Serve as the liaison between the Customer and the Client offshore development team, Participate in requirement workshop activities, Collaborate with Customer Portal COE to develop technical solution design, Document the detail design of each component of the solution Provide input to the detail project plan for the technical tasks, Coordinate / Lead the offshore development teams - Walkthrough the requirements, design and specifications, set up regular status meeting, and ensure the quality of the deliverables, Perform development, and testing activities, Execute train the trainer sessions, Provide technical handover to the Customer team, Participate in weekly project status

 Major Responsibilities & Qualifications: 
 Java/J2EE Development 5 years minimum experience
 HTML5/Java Script Functional & Technical - 5 years minimum experience
 WebSphere Portal 6.0 Functional & Technical - 5 years minimum experience
 JBOSS Functional & Technical - 5 years minimum experience
 Must have excellent customer facing skills
 Must have excellent written and verbal communications skills

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
